Chapter 6171: Here To Kill You, That’S All

Chapter 6171: Here To Kill You, That’s All

“This is Immortal Suppressor?!” Seeing him surprised everyone.

Each individual had a different belief in what he would look like. One form would be an old but enlightened man. Another was an armored combatant with enough divinity to engulf the world.

A bolder speculation included him being an ordinary old man. However, one flick of his wrist could fetch the stars or kill emperors. None expected him to be so young.

Nevertheless, his aura and appearance still impressed them. Despite not exerting his lofty power and simply sitting there, he still looked superior to everyone else.

A while back, Transcendent left an indelible impression on the crowd. However, his style seemed slightly grandiose compared to Immortal Suppressor.

The latter didn’t need to display his brilliance, just sitting there on his lotus throne was plenty to force everyone to submit.

If it wasn’t for Li Qiye, they would be coming to prostrate to the ruler of Sin.

“Immortal Suppressor, he is qualified to rule.” An emperor sighed and said.

After seeing him, all agreed that he was worthy of this position.

“How long can you keep this act up when the dynasty is finished?” Li Qiye asked with a smile.

“The rise and fall of dynasties is a natural concurrence, just a matter of time.” Immortal Suppressor spoke calmly: “It began with me, the birth of a dynasty and the appearance of emperors, don’t you think?”

Others took a deep breath and felt a chill run down their spine. His words couldn’t be clearer - that he didn’t care for the dynasty’s destruction.

He could build another Immortal Suppression Dynasty with more emperors as long as he was around.

In reality, this was indeed the case. The dynasty had produced more than ten emperors. Some died in battle, and some left. Either way, the dynasty was still there because of his existence. In his eyes, emperors were entirely disposable.

Others shuddered upon rumination, Immortal Suppressor has been loyal to Moshi, Dingtian, and Poye. Others weren’t worthy to enter his sight, only tools for him to use to sweep through Sin.

“Those beneath emperors are ants, and so are those beneath primal ancestors.” An emperor sighed and said. After fulfilling his wish of becoming an emperor, he found that this realm was only the beginning.

“Tranquility Emperor was right to leave.” A desolate god said: “I feel bad for Transcendent Emperor, his sacrifice was not even appreciated.”

While the crowd mourned the loss of a great genius and admired his sacrifice, Immortal Suppressor didn’t give it a second thought.

Everyone understood why Tranquility Emperor left. Being the oldest emperor, he certainly understood Immortal Suppressor better than anyone else.

“This is another reason why Tranquility Emperor had always advocated for peace. He didn’t want the dynasty's members to be used as tools or have them die in vain.” An emperor said.

Others agreed with this logic after the fact. Unfortunately, the dynasty didn’t understand this as it grew stronger.

The dead emperors and desolate gods wanted to rule Sin and destroy Enigma, believing this was their ultimate mission.

“If only they could be alive to see this scene and understand Tranquility Emperor’s love for them.” Another said.

Ultimately, they died on the battlefield as nothing more than pawns for Immortal Suppressor.

“I don’t give a shit about someone like you, which is why I’m here to kill you today.” Li Qiye shook his head and said.

“It’s understandable, Dao Brother. You stand with Life and Death Heaven while I stand with Supreme Heaven. A fight between us is inevitable.” Immortal Suppressor said calmly.

“Who cares about those heavens or whatever? My reason for killing you is because you think too highly of yourself.” Li Qiye said.
